name: automagik-workspace
description: One Automagik workspace per VM (Debian 13; 2 CPUs, 4GiB, 20GiB). Server and gate: Automagik 3.146.5, by verified digest; cloudflared 2026.10.7 or Tailscale 1.104.4. Homes and CLI store persist under /data. automagikPnpm pins the baked pnpm 10 path. Final reviewed image digest goes only in settings.serverImage; current pin stays. Give reach, publicUrl, Access settings and memberRunner at create. Created stopped: set TUNNEL_TOKEN or TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY, then instance_start.
